entities.summary: The Japan Evangelical Lutheran Church or JELC is a Lutheran church in Japan. It currently has approximately 21,990 baptized members in 122 congregations nationwide. Japan Evangelical Lutheran Church is a Christian denomination in Asia, established in 1898. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
